description: Fires most strongly (all top activations) when the opponent has three stones stacked vertically on top of the center column (column 3) with the cell above empty, i.e. a must-block in column 3, especially right after they made it, and I have no immediate win. This covers under a fifth of firing; weaker firing is spread over early-game positions (often opponent stones on the left, mine on the right) with no simple rule. Same pattern in other columns barely fires.
effect: Weak. In forced-block positions none (model already plays column 3). In uncertain positions, forcing it high lowers column 3 by about 3-6 points; zeroing it changes almost nothing.
notes: Best dev F1 0.285 (precision 0.78, recall 0.18), sim share 0.01. Vertical col-3 three is clean (minimal pairs: col 3 only, suppressed by my immediate win, drops after a block). The other ~80% of firing is early-game and diffuse, with a left/right asymmetry; side-count, double-threat and col-3 horizontal must-block rules all scored lower. May be a mixture or a near-random direction aligned with a salient center-column threat.
